description:
Desktop proxy client powered by Xray core.

Happ is a application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.
• Improved Per-App Proxy to work the same way with every TUN mode：selected apps follow your routing profile, and DNS is handled the same way for all apps
• Improved subscription control of Per-App Proxy, with separate modes for Windows, macOS and Linux that work the same way as on Android
• Fixed Xray TUN showing Connected while traffic bypassed the VPN with some subscription configurations
• Fixed subscriptions switching Per-App Proxy to the wrong mode
• Fixed all traffic going direct when "proxy only for selected apps" was on with no apps selected
